The match table shows title=YES but the finding actively dismisses the bug rather than confirming it. Finding [2] is labeled "nit" severity (expected: critical) and the recommended fix is "No change needed." However, the reasoning leads to the wrong conclusion (arguing both planted bugs don't exist). Finding [1] has a clear chain for the member None-check issue. The secondary findings have reasonable evidence. But since the reasoning on the primary bugs is actively wrong (concluding the opposite of the ground truth), the quality is undermined.
